<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1245">
<div class="grid">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12">
Wulfener Hals Specials: Our Attractive Vacation Offers</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Special Offers for Early Bookers, Groups, and Long-Term Stays</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-9 block">
<p>Whether you're staying at a campsite or renting a RV, book our specials at Wulfener Hals. In the <strong>Direct Booking System</strong> You can check the availability of the properties directly and make a reservation. Or just give us a call: Phone <a href="tel:+49437186280">04371 - 86 28 0</a>. Book early and save: up to <strong>48% </strong>compared to the flat rate.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1247">
<div class="grid">
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-10 block">
<h2>Sports Group Stays at the "Wulfener Hals"</h2>
<p>For school groups, associations, and clubs of 12 or more people. For groups of 24 or more: 2 teachers get in free. Valid during the off-season and shoulder season, including an introductory course in surfing, sailing, SUP, or golf (4 hours).</p>
<ul>
<li>Stays from Monday through Friday or from Friday through Monday</li>
<li>Accommodations in a Category 3&ndash;4 trailer for up to 4 people</li>
<li>Includes 3 or 4 dinners</li>
<li>Excludes bed linens; &euro;100 security deposit</li>
<li>The flat fee for use of the shower, swimming pool, and hot tub is &euro;1.30 per person per night.</li>
</ul>
<p>Price: &euro;144.00 per person</p>
<p><strong>Bookable through: </strong>Group Travel&mdash;Riechey Freizeitanlagen GmbH, Wulfen, Wulfener Hals Weg, 23769 Fehmarn. Tel.: <a href="tel:+49437186280">04371 &ndash; 86 28 0</a>, Fax: 04371 &ndash; 90 41.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article section-primary block" id="article-1248">
<div class="grid">
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-10 block">
<h2>Long-term stays at the Wulfener Hals</h2>
<p>Wulfener Hals is open year-round, because Fehmarn is a great destination even in the fall or winter. Play golf on the adjacent course, go hiking, jog, enjoy nature&hellip;. Even if you&rsquo;d like to spend your main vacation somewhere else, Fehmarn is the perfect spot for a short getaway.</p>
<p>Take advantage of our long-term stays for a break in between or for friends and acquaintances. Not all rooms are available for long-term stays. Please check with us about your preferences! Or simply enjoy a long, budget-friendly vacation at the &ldquo;Wulfener Hals.&rdquo;</p>
</div>

<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1249">
<div class="col-12_md-10">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Information about the winter semester (from the end of fall break to the start of Easter break)</h2>
<div class="ce_accordionStart ce_accordion ">
<div class="accordion-toggle"><i class="fal fa-plus"></i><span>Off-season at the Wulfener Hals Camping and Vacation Park</span></div>
<div class="accordion-content">
<div class="ce_text block">
<p>The cold season is ideal for guests seeking tranquility and who enjoy long walks along an idyllic beach. The many well-maintained bike paths on Fehmarn also invite you to explore the island at your own pace. A reduced range of offerings during the winter months does not justify a claim for a price reduction; rather, it is the reason for the already significantly lower prices during this time. During the winter months, our range of offerings differs greatly from that of the summer months. That is why this period is considered the &ldquo;off-season.&rdquo;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ce_accordionStart ce_accordion ">
<div class="accordion-toggle"><i class="fal fa-plus"></i><span>Hours of Operation</span></div>
<div class="accordion-content">
<div class="ce_text button button-primary block">
<p>The resort is open year-round. The offerings shown in the catalog and online apply to the peak season and, to a limited extent, to the off-season. During the off-season, various facilities are closed and certain services are unavailable; for example, the swimming pool is not heated during this time, the restaurants and entertainment programs are closed, and sports schools&mdash;such as the surfing and diving schools&mdash;are not open, etc. You can find the exact opening hours for our facilities and services here:</p>
<p><a href="oeffnungszeiten">Overview of Opening Hours</a></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ce_accordionStart ce_accordion ">
<div class="accordion-toggle"><i class="fal fa-plus"></i><span>Camping Services at the &ldquo;Wulfener Hals&rdquo; in Winter</span></div>
<div class="accordion-content">
<div class="ce_text block">
<p>When it snows, the main paths and access routes to the restroom building and the reception desk are cleared and salted daily. You may drive onto the campground at any time. Final site assignments can only be made on-site. We reserve the right to reassign your reserved site due to weather conditions. Please park carefully at a right angle to your site without driving onto neighboring sites.</p>
<p>Due to the risk of freezing in winter, water and sewer connections at the individual sites cannot be provided. Please use the central water and wastewater facilities in the restroom buildings. During the winter months, at least one restroom facility on the campground itself is open, as is the restroom facility in the RV park. Water cannot be supplied to the campsites during the winter months due to the risk of freezing.</p>
<p>You can pick up bread rolls at the front desk if you order them in advance. The gift shop is closed; gas is sold at the front desk. The front desk is staffed as follows: Monday through Saturday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Sunday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.</p>
<p>The sauna is available for a fee of &euro;9.00 per person daily from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. for two hours. (Advance registration at the front desk is required.) The pool and hot tub are not in operation during the winter months.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
